title: Efficient Estimation and Test Power for Separable Recurrent-Event Burden with Terminal Death
banked_reason: D0.5 graded incremental below the field floor: paper_score_ceiling 5.6 < 7.4, salvageable false; mathematics passed and cited sources were verified.
gap_reasons: the attaining inference theorem covers only fixed finite baseline-history tables, where saturated multinomial estimation already supplies root-n nuisance rates.
the substantive shortfall is that continuous-baseline orthogonal inference remains undelivered

The calibrated power result establishes a roughly 5.08% squared-noncentrality improvement on one constructed three-visit path and a continuity neighborhood, without establishing its prevalence or practical importance.

The advertised local frontier supplies a generic CAD and quantifier-elimination procedure for a connected positive-gap set, without computing that region or producing an interpretable boundary criterion.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 constructed a sound hybrid-prefix gradient, exact remainder, finite-cell efficient inference, a calibrated three-visit power witness, and a death-weight calibration counterexample; D0.5 mathematics and cited-source checks passed. The field-tier claim collapsed because the attaining inference theorem remains finite-cell, the power improvement is existential, and the CAD frontier is not computed as an interpretable boundary. A re-raise would need a new continuous-baseline uniform inference theorem and broader power or frontier evidence, not another local repair of this core.
tldr: The identified integrated separable recurrent burden has a hybrid-prefix canonical gradient and exact telescoping nuisance remainder, allowing recurrence to affect later death. The attaining cross-fitted estimator, uniform studentization, and regular-test Gaussian envelope are proved on the stated finite baseline support under explicit estimator-side product rates. The source-faithful PR-MSMaT audit retains death weighting, Kaplan--Meier, and both random risk-set operations. At a three-visit randomized null law, every deterministic vanishing death-weight shift has exact drift \(-71995\delta_n/1179648\): shifts smaller than \(n^{-1/2}\) preserve centering, shifts of that order give a noncentered Gaussian limit, and larger shifts give signed divergence. Because this witness belongs to the published randomized recurrent-event class, uniform consistency alone is insufficient there. The separate calibrated strict-power witness, its positive-margin neighborhood, and the exact local algebraic frontier remain finite-cell results.
gap: Separable recurrent means are identified under qualitative support positivity, and recurrent-count efficiency exists for joint interventions, but no published result supplies the alternating-arm recurrent gradient, its exact coherent remainder, finite-cell nuisance-uniform efficient testing theorem, or a calibrated comparison retaining every derivative of PR-MSMaT's displayed operations.
fill: The project places the causal restrictions on an explicit full-data extension while keeping the target and witnesses as observed-law g-formula functionals, then combines a hybrid-prefix projection theorem, an exact population telescoping identity, finite-cell uniform studentization, a positive-variance least-favourable regular-test envelope, a source-faithful comparison of Appendix II Equations (A.7)--(A.8), and an exact strict-power witness with a relatively open positive-margin neighborhood.
